exposure: Gestational diabetes with poor glycemic control
cohort: Infants born between 34 0/7 weeks and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation.
finding: Prenatal factors (gestational diabetes with poor control, twin pregnancy, gestational age, meconium amniotic fluid, planned cesarean delivery) and postnatal environmental factors (skin-to-skin contact, breastfeeding, type of lightening, body temperature) were associated with early neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean delivery was associated with a higher probability of hypoglycemia.
